Name: L.F. HEAVENLY SOLDOMINA
Information:
**HEAVENLY SOLDOMINA**

A testament to the astral elves’ dedication to the planet they once called home: the core of the original ship they used to leave the planet was powerful enough to elevate a city into exolunar space and propel it through the universe. That ship was pulled apart and rebuilt around that core—a marvel of the Old World—time after time. All of the lunar frame cores for the original non-eidolic lunar frames were made of chunks that had dislodged from the original ship during its journey, leading the astral elves to dream of what its final form might be. The core itself was used as the heart of a lunar frame, with its chassis being made from the remains of that original astral elf city.

Once formed, HEAVENLY SOLDOMINA was used as the ultimate expression of the astral elves’ commitment to protecting the universe from external threats. It has been deployed and damaged several times, always resulting in a lengthy repair period of several centuries, but the lunar frame has saved Somnus Domina from the threat of outer gods and Outer Titans more than once. It is agreed upon within the Astral Confederation that HEAVENLY SOLDOMINA is only to be used when Somnus Domina’s future is on the line, but it has been used as a threat multiple times to discourage the confederation’s enemies.

traits.name: Astral Gate Drive
traits.description: If the frame unit spends at least 1 minute concentrating on doing so, it can produce the effects of the sympathetic gateway spell (requiring no spell slot or components). The frame unit counts as a vessel with a gate drive.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The frame unit attacks twice with its World Strike, then twice with its Protoarcanic Barrage.

actions.name: World Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 50 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 20 (3d12) psychic damage.

actions.name: Protoarcanic Barrage
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 800/2400 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d12) psychic damage plus 26 (4d12) force damage.

actions.name: The Fall of Heaven (1/Rest)
actions.description: The frame unit creates a superplanetary hole in space that leads to the Astral Plane, formed in the shape of a spear. It hurls it at a point it can see within 5 miles, where it creates an interplanar fissure in the shape of a 300-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that space must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 20d12 force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures who fail by 10 points or more are hurled through the fissure into another plane, as though by the plane shift spell, and a gate signature lingers there as though produced by the sympathetic gateway spell.

actions.name: Warping Pummel
actions.description: The frame unit teleports into an unoccupied space it can see within 1200 feet and makes two World Strike attacks, each with advantage.

reactions.name: Reinvention Gate
reactions.description: In response to being targeted by an attack, the frame unit can force the attacker to make a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it quickly opens a gate to block the attack, redirecting it and making another creature the frame unit chooses within 240 feet the new target.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The lunar frame moves up to its movement speed.

legendary_actions.name: Warp Strike
legendary_actions.description: The frame unit teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 480 feet and makes one World Strike against a target in range. On a hit, if the target is Gargantuan or smaller they are knocked prone.

legendary_actions.name: Extermination Volley (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The frame unit unleashes a barrage of eidoarcanic attacks at a target point it can see within 1000 feet. They strike everything in a 100-foot-radius sphere centered on that point, forcing each creature in that area to make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 39 (6d12) force damage on a failure.

legendary_actions.name: Astral Graveyard (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The frame unit chooses a point it can see within range, and warps space debris from another plane into that space. Any zero-gravity environment within 1 mile of the debris becomes a Density 10 debris field for 1 hour, or until the frame unit uses this Legendary Action again to dispel or move it.
